To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Salicylic acid pretreatment of shrimp shells improves significantly the efficiency of chitin and chitin extraction from shrimp waste.

pretreatment of black tiger shrimp shells with 0.040 M Salicylic Acid for ten hours, prior to demineralization and deproteinization at ambient temperature, results in a 75-20% reduction in chemical consumption, a 50-20% reduction of treatment duration, and a 50% reduction of ash and protein residues, whereas viscosity and absence insolubles are improved by a factor up to 2.5.

pretreatment of shrimp waste with 0.040 M salicylic acid for 10 h at ambient temperature followed by treatment of the pretreated shells at ambient temperature using a 2:1 ratio of HCl and NaOH (8 h) is the most efficient method for the preparation of shrimp chitin and chitoan with improved characteristics.

the development of a new method of chitin and chito-sans production using shrimp waste as a starting material.
the use of Salicylic acid as an efficient pretreatment of shrimp shell wastes, in order to obtain high quality chitin and chitin derivatives.
a new method for chitin/chitosan production from black tiger shrimp shells.

pretreatment of shrimp shells with Salicylic acid at 10 o C for 10 hours is a good method for improving the characteristics of the chitin and chitoan produced.
Salicylic acid treatment of the shrimp shells before demineralization and deproteinization is an efficient method of improving the properties and quality of the chitin and chitin products.
pretreatment of black tiger shrimp waste using 0.04M Salicylic acid is a promising and effective way to produce chitin and chitin derivatives with improved properties.

the use of salicylic acid pretreatment of shrimp shells prior to demineralization and deproteinization could significantly reduce the chemical consumption, duration of the treatments, ash and protein contents in the final chitin and chitin, while the viscosity and solubility of the product improved.

the Salicylic acid pretreatment of black tiger shrimp shells is an efficient and cost-effective method for the production of high purity chitin and chitin with improved characteristics.

the pretreatment of the shrimp shells with 0.40 M Salicylic Acid for ten hours prior to the demineralization and deproteinization processes, significantly improved the quality of the isolated chitin and chitin, which is a very important factor for the commercial use of the products.
